title: ERC-7730 test file
description: A test file of the ERC-7730 spec tests. It is a superset of the registry's erc7730-tests-v2.schema.json: every registry test file is valid here. A file is either a rendering file (descriptor + cases with expected output, the default) or a validation file (kind: validation; descriptors an implementation must accept or reject).

descriptor.description: Relative path to the ERC-7730 descriptor under test, resolved from the directory of the test file.

specVersion.description: The spec version the file belongs to: the version key of the schema file, or 'next' for the draft. Equal to the name of the version folder.

caseId.description: Stable identifier of the case, unique across the suite. Words joined by '-', grouped by '/'; format names keep their spec spelling (tokenAmount). Never renamed; a wrong case is removed, and its id is not reused.

specReference.description: Where the spec requires this behaviour.

section.description: The heading path in ERCS/erc-7730.md, parts joined by ' > ', e.g. 'Field formats > tokenAmount'.

quote.description: The sentence of the spec that states the requirement, copied verbatim.

until.description: The first spec version in which this case no longer applies, because that version changed the behaviour. A runner that targets that version or a newer one skips the case.

dataProvider.description: Mock data injected into the runner so cases do not need the network. Address keys are lower-case 0x-prefixed.

tokens.description: Address → ERC-20 metadata. A key may be prefixed with the chain id as 'eip155:<chainId>:' when the same address means a different token on another chain.

addressNames.description: Address → local display name (contact labels, contract names). ENS reverse names go in ensNames so that sources: ["local"] matches only local labels.

blockTimestamps.description: Block height (decimal string key) → Unix timestamp in seconds.

chainNames.description: Chain id (decimal string key) → chain name, for the chainId format.

call.description: The decoded transaction that rawTx encodes. tools/encode-call.mjs builds rawTx from it as an unsigned EIP-1559 transaction with nonce 0, gas 1000000, maxFeePerGas 1 gwei and maxPriorityFeePerGas 1 gwei. tools/check.mjs fails when rawTx and call disagree.

value.description: Native value in wei, decimal or 0x-hex string. Default 0.

function.description: Human-readable function signature with parameter names, as a display.formats key is written, e.g. 'transfer(address to,uint256 value)'. Omit it for a transaction with empty or opaque calldata.

args.description: The argument values in order. Integers as decimal or 0x-hex strings, addresses as 0x strings, bytes as 0x strings, booleans as booleans, tuples as objects keyed by component name, arrays as arrays.

data.description: Opaque calldata, used instead of function + args.

calldataTest.description: A case for a calldata descriptor.

description.description: What the case shows. Unique within the file; runners that predate id key results on it.

from.description: Checksummed signer address. Set only when the descriptor reads @.from.

eip712Test.description: A case for an EIP-712 descriptor.

from.description: Checksummed signer address. Set only when the descriptor reads @.from.

noMatch.description: The descriptor must not be applied to this input. The runner reports status pass when the implementation refuses the descriptor for this input, whatever it shows instead.

renderedOutput.description: What a wallet shows. Mirrored by cases[].rendered in results.json.

intent.description: The intent of the matched format: the string, or the object form copied as is.

interpolatedIntent.description: The interpolatedIntent with every {path} replaced by the formatted field value. Omit when the format has none.

owner.description: metadata.owner of the descriptor. Omit when the descriptor has none.

fields.description: Ordered list of rendered fields in descriptor order, visible ones only. value is the formatted string, or a nested renderedOutput for a calldata field whose descriptor resolved. Labels can repeat when a path iterates an array.

validationTest.description: A descriptor that an implementation must accept, or must reject with an error of the given category.

descriptor.description: Relative path to the descriptor, resolved from the directory of the test file.

error.description: Required when valid is false. The category of the error; the message is implementation-specific.
